items.title: Ricard Alexis Interview, 1959-01-16
items.q: I got mail from him right there. I keep in my box right now.

ctx.x: Lil. Lil. Lil. Lil Harden. Yeah.

She talked with him just like schooling. You couldn't understand what he was writing when he left here. But now that we're getting mail from him, I got mail from him right there. I keep in my box right now.
